title: Étale prime-power quotient map into an adapted admissible subalgebra
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $\Lambda$ a Noetherian $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $q\subset\Lambda$ a prime, $n\ge1$, $L=\Lambda_q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $J=qL$, $B=L/J^n$, and $\pi:L\to B$ the quotient map. Let $A\subset B$ be a local $k$-subalgebra with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_A$, admissible [def-weil-pbc-popescu-admissible-subalgebra] for $JB$, and assume $\mathfrak m_A=A\cap JB$. Fix $m\ge0$ and $\varphi:k[y_1,\ldots,y_m]\to\Lambda$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], put $p=\varphi^{-1}(q)$ and $P=k[y]_p$, and fix a flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] ring map $\psi:P\to L$ extending $\Lambda\to L$ composed with $\varphi$. Assume $qL=pL$. Suppose $a_j\in A$ map to $\pi(\varphi(y_j))$ and their residue differentials span $\Omega_{F/k}$ over $F=A/\mathfrak m_A$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Then there is a ring map $f:P/(pP)^n\to A$ sending the maximal ideal into $\mathfrak m_A$, étale (finitely presented, formally smooth [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], with zero relative Kähler differentials), whose composite with $A\hookrightarrow B$ and $P\to P/(pP)^n$ equals $\pi\circ\psi$. No coordinates are chosen, and neither characteristic nor geometric regularity is assumed.

proof.text: The polynomial evaluation factors through $A$ because its variable and coefficient images lie in $A$. Elements outside $p$ map outside $JB$, hence outside $\mathfrak m_A$ by contraction, hence to units of $A$. Extend to $P\to A$ by [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Its composite with inclusion equals $\pi\psi$ by localization uniqueness. Since $qL=pL$, this composite kills $(pP)^n$. Inclusion is injective, so quotient universality gives $f:P/(pP)^n\to A$ and its compatibility equation. It is local because $p$ maps into the contracted maximal ideal.

proof.text: The private proved specialization flat_quotient_map identifies the target quotient with the tensor base change by [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-quotient-base-change]. Flatness follows from [lem-weil-pbc-flat-module-base-change]. The explicit quotient factorization identifies this map with the composite of f and the inclusion. The inclusion is local by maximal-ideal contraction and flat by admissibility; hence it is faithfully flat by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-local-hom-faithfully-flat]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-permanence] to descend flatness to f.

source.place: Proof of Tag 07FH (lemma-solution-modulo); read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07FH

proof.text: Both quotients are nontrivial and local: their defining prime powers lie in the maximal ideals of the localizations, and quotient maps are surjective. Their maximal ideals are the images of pP and qL. Map the source maximal ideal along f and then into B; compatibility and pL=qL identify its image with JB. Admissibility gives the same image for the maximal ideal of A. Contract both ideals using [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ideal-contraction] to obtain m_Q A=m_A. No Artinian property of the source quotient is needed.

source.place: Proof of Tag 07FH (lemma-solution-modulo); read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07FH

proof.text: The explicitly constructed f respects k and sends the images of all polynomial variables to the a_j. Put Q=P/(pP)^n and F=A/m_A. Essential finite type over k descends to essential finite type over Q. The surjective map Omega(F/k) to Omega(F/Q) sends every spanning coordinate differential to zero, since each coordinate residue comes from Q. Thus Omega(F/Q)=0. Restricting scalars from Q to its residue field shows that F/kappa(Q) is formally unramified, hence separable and finite by [lem-weil-pbc-fg-field-zero-differentials-separable]. This directly proves the differential step in Lean, without selecting field generators.

source.place: Proof of Tag 07FH (lemma-solution-modulo); read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07FH

proof.text: The finite residue field extension makes F finite as a Q-module, since kappa(Q) is a quotient of Q. The Jacobson radical of the local ring A is its maximal ideal. Admissibility gives IsArtinianRing A, so [lem-weil-pbc-artinian-finite-over-residue-finite], implemented by IsSemiprimaryRing.finite_of_isArtinian, makes A finite over Q. Thus A is of finite type. Polynomial Noetherianity, localization, and quotient give a Noetherian Q; [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-noetherian-finite-presentation] yields finite presentation.

source.place: Proof of Tag 07FH (lemma-solution-modulo); read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07FH

proof.text: The finite separable residue field extension and m_Q A=m_A give Algebra.FormallyUnramified Q A by Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_map_maximalIdeal. Together with the proved flatness and finite presentation, apply Algebra.Etale.of_formallyUnramified_of_flat, the Mathlib realization of [lem-weil-pbc-local-flat-unramified-etale]. This criterion directly gives Etale Q A; no passage through the etale locus or uniqueness of the target prime is required.
